brief:
Qatar's Emir Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani condemned Israeli military actions in Lebanon, Syria, and Palestine during remarks at the 81st session of the United Nations General Assembly, the Middle East Eye reported. The emir's statements marked a formal rebuke of Israeli operations across the three territories.

Details of the specific operations or the full scope of the emir's remarks were not immediately available.

title: Qatar's emir condemns Israeli operations in Syria, Lebanon, Palestine
